prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached Old Quay concept. Preserve EVERY existing building, the harbour hall and square, both bridges, the continuous long shop building on the right, all roads, shoreline, harbour water outline, amber district boundary, camera, scale, lighting and composition. Change ONLY the currently empty harbour basin water by adding TWO MODEST MARINA DOCK CLUSTERS WITH MOORED YACHTS. Each has one slim gangway connected visibly to the existing quay promenade, a short main floating pontoon and two or three perpendicular short finger pontoons. Docks must be connected to land, not floating disconnected or driven over. About SIX MOORED YACHTS TOTAL distributed between the two clusters, not a packed marina. Use two recognisably different stylized boat designs: compact sleek white motor yachts with dark teal glazing, plus a couple of elegant small sailing yachts with furled sails and simple masts. Broad clean hull/deck shapes; tasteful muted coral/navy accents; soft warm cabin lights. Approximate boat lengths10-18m relative to the small buildings; no giant superyachts, no cruise ships, no fishing boats. Slim quiet dark timber/composite dock decks with a few mooring cleats and restrained warm lamps; no dock shops, buildings or dense rope clutter. Preserve a GENEROUS OPEN CENTRAL WATER AREA and an unobstructed corridor to the SOUTHERN HARBOUR ENTRANCE UNDER THE ROAD BRIDGE. Do not put boats or docks underneath the bridge or block the open mouth. Boats are tied up and stationary, not under way; no wakes or marine action. Do not change water levels, coastline, land area, piers outside the harbour, buildings or roads. Smooth stylized3D at blue hour, exact same overhead camera and framing as the input. No new labels, text, people on boats, UI, arrows or diagram keys. The request is a visual concept for docks and yachts, not sailing gameplay.
